The atm-bd command must have a skill subcommand that installs the atm-bd-orchestration skill into a repository by running the same installer logic as plugins/atm-bd-orchestration/install.py, the atm-bd-console command must remain available as an alias, and the skill subcommand must not offer a skill-set selector option such as --profile.

anchors.quote: we really always want to upgrade to most recent.
anchors.context: planning session 2026-10-17: head of main as default, agreed
anchors.summary: skill fetched from main head by default; --ref overrides
anchors.scope: changes how the skill subcommand locates skill files
anchors.deterministic_check: run atm-bd skill with network traces or a local clone and confirm the installed files equal main's head; run with --ref <branch> and confirm that branch's files

history.reason: skill sources redesigned: bare=bundled, x.y.z=tag, --latest=main head (ANC-010..012)
